method: Same harness as redstone-reference.json (RedstoneProbe: real World/Chunk, copied WorldServer pending ticks, recorded sounds/drops, scripted entity list with strict AABB intersection). Native BlockTripWireHook and BlockTripWire run unchanged. Events: place (setBlock flags 3), place2 (flags 2), placehook (setBlock flags 3 then Block.onPostBlockPlaced(meta), as ItemBlock.placeBlockAt), air, entity (0 item, 1 mob, 2 player: 0.25 box on the cell floor), unentity, collide (onEntityCollidedWithBlock, null entity), notify. Not probed: shears disarm (onBlockHarvested), selection bounds, random ticks. Per tick: changed region cells, call log (E event, s setBlock, m setBlockMetadataWithNotify, n notify, t schedule, u updateTick, p sound, e drop, T tick), sounds, drops, pending ticks, world Random nextInt.

scenarios.name: placement-then-trip
scenarios.note: hook, four strings, hook placed with flags 3 (the 3-flag onBlockAdded runs), an entity trips the line at tick 10 and leaves at 30, a string is broken at 45

scenarios.name: flags2-placement
scenarios.note: hooks with unattached metadata, strings written with flags 2 and metadata 4 (no onBlockAdded for the string's neighbours), then tripped by a player

scenarios.name: generated-state-trip
scenarios.note: the inert metadata the structure generator writes (hooks facing|4, strings 4) behaves like a settled line when an item entity touches it

scenarios.name: z-line-power
scenarios.note: z-axis line; the powered hook strongly powers its anchor block, driving wire and lamp on top of and beside it

scenarios.name: suspended-line
scenarios.note: strings over a hole stay suspended (metadata 2); placing a floor block under one drops it because the suspended bit no longer matches

scenarios.name: break-hook-powered
scenarios.note: the powered hook is broken: far hook and strings lose attached/powered, the hook drops

scenarios.name: break-string-powered
scenarios.note: a string is broken while an entity trips the line

scenarios.name: break-anchor
scenarios.note: the anchor block of a hook is broken, so the hook drops and the line unattaches

scenarios.name: break-floor-string
scenarios.note: the floor under a string is broken: the string's suspended bit no longer matches and it drops

scenarios.name: gap-and-obstruction
scenarios.note: a glass block in the line, replaced by a string, then another obstruction, a gap and a refill

scenarios.name: range-41
scenarios.note: far hook 41 cells from the first hook (the scan covers 41)

scenarios.name: range-42
scenarios.note: far hook 42 cells from the first hook (the scan covers 41)

scenarios.name: same-facing-hooks
scenarios.note: both hooks face the same way: no far hook is found and the line never attaches

scenarios.name: disarmed-string
scenarios.note: one disarmed string (metadata |8) is part of an attached line; tripping another string unattaches the line and never powers the hooks

scenarios.name: two-strings-tripped
scenarios.note: an item trips one string, a player a second; the line stays powered until both leave

scenarios.name: hook-replaced-while-powered
scenarios.note: the far hook is broken while powered and placed again: the line re-attaches and powers again if an entity is still there
